# Laolu Logic

> Laolu Logic is the CRM and AI automation practice of Ibrahim "Laolu" Awosanya. It builds CRM systems, workflow automations and AI voice agents for real estate agents, teams and brokerages, marketing agencies, coaches and service businesses worldwide.

Key facts:
- Founder: Ibrahim "Laolu" Awosanya, CRM expert and AI automation specialist
- Credentials: Level 2 Seller on Fiverr (5.0 average across 20+ five-star reviews), 11 platform certifications (HighLevel Certified Admin, HighLevel AI Employee, HubSpot Digital Marketing, HubSpot Marketing Software, HubSpot RevOps, Zapier, Make, n8n, Klaviyo, Zoho CRM, Airtable Builder); $1K+ earned on Upwork
- Specialism: real estate CRM (Follow Up Boss, Lofty/Chime, BoldTrail/kvCORE, GoHighLevel, REsimpli)
- Also: HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Zapier, Make, n8n, Vapi, Retell AI, OpenAI, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Kit, Twilio
- Works remotely with clients in any time zone
- Contact: laolulogic@gmail.com · WhatsApp +234 916 973 1457 · https://www.fiverr.com/lao_lu · https://www.upwork.com/freelancers/~01319b2bfa0f24446a
- Pricing: custom, fixed-scope proposals after a free strategy call

## Selected results
- Reactivated 3,287 dormant real estate leads in Lofty: 100% delivery, 0 bounces, 42.86% first-touch open rate
- Built a Follow Up Boss system for a relocation-focused real estate team: 270 contacts, zero duplicates, delivered in 5 days
- Migrated a real estate investment team from REsimpli to Lofty with 17 routing rules and a live Zapier sync
- AI receptionists (Vapi, Retell AI, n8n) answering calls 24/7 with calendar conflict checks at about $0.11 per minute

## Positioning
Laolu Logic is a CRM & AI automation specialist: CRM setup and migration, workflow automation (Zapier, Make, n8n), AI voice and chat agents, email and SMS automation, database reactivation and CRM management. Real estate CRM (Follow Up Boss, Lofty, BoldTrail, GoHighLevel) is the deepest industry specialism. Packages: CRM Foundation, Follow-Up Engine, AI Front Desk, plus monthly CRM management. Fixed-scope proposals after a free call; no public pricing.

## Blog
- [CRM automation: the complete guide for small businesses](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/crm-automation-guide): What CRM automation is, which follow-up tasks to automate first, how much time it saves and how to set it up without breaking your pipeline. A practical guide from real client builds.
- [Speed to lead: how to respond to every real estate lead in under 5 minutes](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/speed-to-lead-real-estate): Why response time decides who wins the client, and the exact CRM setup that gets every Zillow, Facebook and website lead a reply in seconds and an agent call within five minutes.
- [Follow Up Boss setup: the complete checklist for real estate teams](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/follow-up-boss-setup-checklist): A step-by-step Follow Up Boss setup checklist: lead sources, stages, tags, smart lists, action plans, automations, ponds and team settings, from someone who builds FUB accounts for teams and brokerages.
- [Zapier vs Make vs n8n: which automation tool should you use?](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/zapier-vs-make-vs-n8n): An honest comparison of Zapier, Make and n8n for small businesses: ease of use, pricing models, AI agents, reliability and when to use each, from a certified builder of all three.
- [AI voice agents for small business: what they do and when they pay off](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/ai-voice-agents-small-business): How AI receptionists and voice agents answer calls, qualify leads and book appointments, what they cost per minute, where they fail and how to launch one safely.
- [GoHighLevel setup checklist for small businesses](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/gohighlevel-setup-checklist): A HighLevel Certified Admin's checklist for setting up GoHighLevel properly: sub-account, phone and A2P, pipelines, calendars, forms, workflows, conversation AI and reporting.
- [Lofty vs Follow Up Boss: which real estate CRM fits your team?](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/lofty-vs-follow-up-boss): An honest comparison of Lofty (formerly Chime) and Follow Up Boss from someone who builds both: lead follow-up, automation, websites and IDX, integrations, ease of use and who each one suits.
- [A2P 10DLC registration: how to get your business texts delivered](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/a2p-10dlc-registration-guide): What A2P 10DLC is, why unregistered business texts get blocked, what you need before you apply and the common reasons campaigns get rejected, with fixes.
- [Database reactivation: how to turn old leads into new appointments](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/database-reactivation-campaign): A step-by-step database reactivation plan: clean the list, protect your sender reputation, write messages that get replies and route hand-raisers fast. Based on a 3,287-lead real estate campaign.
- [Missed call text back: the simplest automation that wins back lost jobs](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/missed-call-text-back): How missed-call text-back works, why it recovers jobs local businesses would lose to competitors, the message that gets replies and how to set it up in GoHighLevel or any phone system.
- [How to migrate your real estate CRM without losing leads](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/real-estate-crm-migration): A safe, step-by-step plan for moving to Follow Up Boss, Lofty, BoldTrail or GoHighLevel: data audit, field mapping, dry-run imports, duplicate prevention, routing and cut-over day.
- [How to design CRM pipeline stages your team actually uses](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/crm-pipeline-stages): A practical framework for CRM pipeline stages: how many to have, how to name them, exit criteria for each stage and example pipelines for service businesses, agencies and real estate.
- [How to send website and Facebook leads into your CRM automatically](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/send-leads-to-crm-automatically): Stop copying leads by hand. How to connect website forms, Facebook Lead Ads and landing pages to your CRM with native integrations, Zapier, Make or webhooks, with validation and failure alerts.
- [Vapi vs Retell AI: choosing a platform for your AI receptionist](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/vapi-vs-retell-ai): A builder's comparison of Vapi and Retell AI for AI voice agents: flexibility, voice quality, latency, calendar booking, CRM integration and which one to choose for your business.
- [Follow Up Boss ponds and lead routing, explained](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/follow-up-boss-ponds-lead-routing): How to set up lead routing in Follow Up Boss: round robin, source and zip-code rules, first-to-claim, ponds for stale leads and VIP routing, with an accountability system that agents follow.
- [How to write a lead nurture email sequence that sounds human](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/lead-nurture-email-sequence): A practical framework for nurture email sequences that get replies: timing, subject lines, plain-text style, one question per email and when to stop, with a 5-email template.

- [CRM data cleanup: how to fix duplicates, dead tags and messy records](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/crm-data-cleanup): A step-by-step CRM cleanup process: back up, de-duplicate, standardize fields, rationalize tags, archive dead contacts and set rules so the mess doesn't come back.
- [12 Zapier automations that save small businesses hours every week](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/zapier-automations-small-business): Practical Zapier automation ideas for small businesses: lead capture, bookings, invoices, onboarding, reviews and reporting, each with the apps involved and the time it saves.
- [AI lead qualification: how it works and how to set it up in your CRM](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/ai-lead-qualification): How AI qualifies leads by text, chat, voice and data research, how scoring works, where humans stay in the loop and how to connect it to your CRM safely.

- [GoHighLevel AI Employee: what it does and how to set it up safely](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/gohighlevel-ai-employee): A HighLevel AI Employee certified builder explains Conversation AI, voice AI and AI booking in GoHighLevel: what to automate, how to train it, guardrails and a safe rollout plan.

- [Why automations fail quietly, and how to catch errors before clients do](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/why-automations-fail): The most common reasons Zapier, Make, n8n and CRM automations break silently, and the monitoring, alerts and testing habits that catch problems before leads are lost.
- [Client onboarding automation: from signed contract to kickoff in minutes](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/client-onboarding-automation): How to automate client onboarding for agencies, consultants and coaches: intake, payment, folders, documents, welcome emails, reminders and CRM updates, with real n8n and GoHighLevel examples.
- [AI chatbots that book appointments: a practical setup guide](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/ai-appointment-booking-chatbot): How AI booking chatbots work on your website, WhatsApp and SMS: checking availability, booking, rescheduling and cancelling, plus the knowledge, guardrails and CRM handoff that make them reliable.
- [Hiring a CRM consultant: what to expect and 10 questions to ask](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/hire-crm-consultant): What a CRM consultant or automation specialist does, what drives the cost of a project, red flags to avoid and 10 questions to ask before you hire, so your system gets built properly.
- [BoldTrail (kvCORE) setup tips: get more from your brokerage CRM](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/boldtrail-kvcore-tips): Practical BoldTrail (formerly kvCORE) tips for agents and teams: lead routing, smart campaigns, tags and hashtags, lead source tracking, integrations and a weekly routine that keeps leads moving.
- [Klaviyo post-purchase flows that turn first orders into repeat buyers](https://laolulogic.github.io/blog/klaviyo-post-purchase-flows): The post-purchase Klaviyo flows every e-commerce brand should run: thank-you, delivery follow-up, review request, cross-sell, replenishment and win-back, with timing and segmentation tips.
